job.title: CONFIDENTIAL Manager/Sr. Manager, Growth Marketing
job.description:
Our client, a high-growth Sephora brand, is seeking a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to drive customer acquisition, revenue growth, and marketing efficiency across digital and retail channels. This individual will play a key role in executing and optimizing performance marketing initiatives, partnering with external agencies and internal teams to identify new opportunities, scale successful campaigns, and improve customer acquisition. The role will focus on building scalable testing strategies across creative, audiences, messaging, and digital customer experiences to support sustainable, profitable growth. This hybrid role requires an on-site schedule 2-3 days per week in Los Angeles.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the execution and optimization of paid digital marketing campaigns across social media and emerging advertising channels.
  • Partner with external agencies to launch, evaluate, and scale campaigns against customer acquisition, return on investment, and revenue objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency through audience development, creative optimization, bidding strategies, and budget allocation.
  • Monitor campaign spending and performance, support forecasting, and provide regular reporting on progress against business objectives.
  • Develop and manage a structured creative testing strategy across paid marketing channels.
  • Collaborate with agency and internal creative partners to test new concepts, messaging, formats, content, and promotional strategies.
  • Partner with creative and influencer teams to source and develop content that supports campaign performance.
  • Monitor content budgets, usage rights, and spending to ensure alignment with established plans.
  • Translate campaign results into actionable insights and opportunities for creative improvement.
  • Identify and evaluate new opportunities to attract customers and improve marketing performance through ongoing experimentation.
  • Develop and execute tests across advertising campaigns, digital experiences, offers, and customer conversion journeys.
  • Conduct A/B testing to optimize website content, messaging, product education, and calls to action.
  • Collaborate with digital and development partners to improve conversion rates and overall customer value.
  • Evaluate emerging platforms, technologies, and growth strategies to identify opportunities for continued expansion.
  • Partner with internal teams to identify and evaluate content creators and partnership opportunities that support customer acquisition.
  • Expand the reach of high-performing creator content through paid marketing initiatives.
  • Support testing across emerging commerce and advertising channels, evaluating their potential to contribute to broader marketing and revenue objectives.
  • Monitor daily and weekly campaign performance, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop recurring performance reports that translate data into actionable insights and testing priorities.
  • Support marketing measurement initiatives, including attribution analysis, incrementality testing, and campaign effectiveness studies.
  • Evaluate performance across multiple measurement methods to inform budget allocation and investment decisions.
  • Translate analytical findings into recommendations that improve acquisition efficiency and sustainable growth.
  • Partner with Brand, Creative, Ecommerce, CRM, Influencer, Sales, and external agency teams to coordinate marketing initiatives and product launches.
  • Align digital campaigns with broader brand priorities, promotional calendars, and retail marketing initiatives.
  • Coordinate campaign execution across multiple channels and markets, ensuring initiatives are delivered on schedule and aligned with business objectives.
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, or digital acquisition, ideally within a high-growth beauty and/or consumer-facing brand that has both DTC and retail (Sephora) distribution
  • Demonstrated experience managing and scaling paid social campaigns across Meta & TikTok.
  • Strong understanding of performance creative, audience strategy, and campaign optimization.
  • Experience leveraging creator partnerships and user-generated content to support paid marketing performance.
  • Proven ability to manage external paid media agencies and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience with digital analytics, attribution, and marketing performance measurement platforms.
  • Familiarity with marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, and data-driven budget allocation.
  • Working knowledge of ecommerce platforms (such as Shopify), customer relationship management tools, and emerging technologies that improve marketing efficiency.

job.title: Senior Manager, Talent Development — US Region
job.city: Culver City OR New York, NY
job.description:
Our client, a global, fast-growing consumer retail brand is seeking a Senior Manager, Talent Development to lead learning, leadership development, performance management, succession planning, and early career initiatives across the United States. This strategic leadership role will be responsible for building and scaling talent development programs that strengthen organizational capability, enhance employee growth, and support long-term business objectives. The position will partner closely with Human Resources leadership, business stakeholders, and global teams to create a comprehensive talent development framework that drives employee engagement, performance, and career progression. This role is based full-time onsite in their office located in Culver City, CA.

What You'll Do
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive Talent Development strategy that supports organizational growth, workforce capability building, and long-term talent objectives.
  • Conduct ongoing organizational and learning needs assessments to identify skill gaps, leadership development opportunities, and workforce development priorities.
  • Partner with business leaders and Human Resources teams to design targeted learning programs and career development pathways for key employee populations.
  • Lead the creation and execution of annual learning and development plans aligned with business goals, workforce needs, and employee development priorities.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate training programs focused on leadership development, management effectiveness, professional skills, onboarding, and employee growth.
  • Establish measurement frameworks to assess learning effectiveness, participant engagement, and return on investment for development initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary owner and administrator of the organization's Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring an engaging, accessible, and effective learning experience.
  • Oversee LMS configuration, content management, learning pathways, reporting, compliance tracking, and continuous platform optimization.
  • Partner with HRIS and technology teams to implement system enhancements, integrations, and new learning capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain learning analytics dashboards that provide actionable insights into participation, completion rates, compliance, and employee development trends.
  • Lead the localization and execution of global learning programs, ensuring content is relevant, compliant, and effective for the U.S. workforce.
  • Manage program logistics, stakeholder communications, facilitator coordination, and participant engagement for learning initiatives.
  • Design and implement a structured succession planning framework that identifies critical roles and develops robust leadership pipelines.
  • Facilitate talent review and succession planning discussions with business leaders and Human Resources partners.
  • Partner with managers to create and monitor Individual Development Plans (IDPs) for high-potential employees and succession candidates.
  • Track talent pipeline strength, successor readiness, and leadership development progress through ongoing reporting and analytics.
  • Lead the design, administration, and continuous improvement of performance management programs, including goal-setting, performance reviews, calibration processes, and employee development planning.
  • Develop manager training, resources, and toolkits that support effective coaching, feedback conversations, and performance management practices.
  • Foster a culture of continuous feedback, employee growth, and development through scalable learning and coaching initiatives.
  • Build and manage early-career talent programs, including internships, university partnerships, leadership development initiatives, and internal mobility pathways.
  • Develop relationships with educational institutions, industry organizations, and talent communities to strengthen future talent pipelines.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and business leaders on campus recruiting initiatives, internship programs, and emerging talent strategies.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and business leadership to ensure talent development programs are integrated into broader people strategies.
  • Provide data-driven insights and recommendations on workforce capability, employee development, succession readiness, and organizational talent health.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Learning & Development, or a related field required.
  • 7+ years of progressive Human Resources experience with a significant focus on Talent Development, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or Talent Management.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-wide learning, leadership development, and talent management programs.
  • Strong background in succession planning, performance management, talent reviews, career development, and employee growth initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience administering and optimizing Learning Management Systems (LMS), including reporting, content management, and learning pathway configuration.
  • Experience conducting organizational learning needs assessments and translating findings into strategic development plans.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable talent development programs within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage audiences ranging from frontline employees to executive leadership.
  • Experience leveraging talent analytics, dashboards, and workforce metrics to evaluate program effectiveness and inform decision-making.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Strong understanding of performance management practices, leadership development methodologies, and talent management frameworks.
  • Experience collaborating within matrixed and global organizations.
  • Excellent communication, project management, and relationship-building skills.

New Business Development & Sales Execution

  • Own the full front end of the sales cycle for new business, focused on sourcing, qualifying, and advancing new enterprise opportunities.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline by identifying and engaging specialty retailers that fit the company’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), including industry alignment and spend size.

Collaboration & Deal Progression

  • Partner closely with the CRO and broader leadership team to progress opportunities and support deal closure.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment across product positioning, value proposition, and client needs.

 

Pipeline Strategy & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, prioritization, and follow-through.
  • Track qualified leads, opportunity progression, and revenue contribution with a strong sense of urgency and accountability.

  • 7+ years of enterprise sales or business development experience, with a strong emphasis on new logo acquisition.
  • Required: Deep experience selling retail technology, specifically within the specialty retail space.
  • Proven success selling B2B SaaS solutions with complex buying cycles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through relationships, industry presence, and proactive outreach.
  • Strong executive presence with exceptional presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Comfort operating autonomously as a senior individual contributor with a pure selling mindset.
